quote: When I came to Progressive Ideal Trust, I was scared and alone. Today, I am a university student studying to become a doctor. The orphanage gave me not just a home, but a family and a future.
author: Sarah M.

quote: The support I received at Progressive Ideal Trust changed my life. I learned computer skills, finished school, and now I work as a software developer. I'm forever grateful.
author: James K.

quote: As a monthly donor, I've seen firsthand how every dollar makes a difference. The transparency and dedication of the team is remarkable. These children truly have a chance at a better life.
author: Maria L.
